item.summary: fix(gateway): recover phantom 'running' sessions when a terminal projection is lost (#123192) The synchronous lifecycle listener stamps projectSessionTerminalPending before the async chat handler clears the tracked run. If that handler pass is lost (run-context claim revoked between emit and dispatch, handler exception swallowed by the dispatch catch, or a cached lazy-load rejection), the entry stayed pinned forever: sessions.list kept a phantom active run with a dead Stop control, the chat dedupe key never expired, and managed-media cleanup skipped the session until restart. The maintenance sweeper skipped every terminal-pending entry unconditionally. Age-bound that skip with the already-stamped projectSessionTerminalObservedAt and the existing AGENT_RUN_TERMINAL_RETRY_GRACE_MS: overdue entries fall into the ordinary terminal-safe expiry branches. Fresh abort-owner reservations (no stamped observation) remain untouched.
